# Antérieur — proposition visuelle v1

Illustration produite avec l’outil intégré image_gen. La scène représente une observation du passé, sans modification historique. Anatomie proposée.

[Image](anterieur-v1.png)

## Prompt

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a cinematic painterly photoreal dark fantasy illustration of an ANTERIEUR, an original instinctive non-living creature encountered only while magically observing a past scene. Scene: an old medieval timber-supported stone gallery BEFORE its collapse, intact overhead beams and dusty stone floor. Main subject, clearly visible in upper foreground resting between two low beams: a compact strange animal with many slender articulated limbs folded into intricate nested geometrical configurations, an interlocked organic knot, delicate ivory-dark mineral cuticle, taut fine connective tissue. It is an ANIMAL with a coherent central body, not a sculpture, machine or humanoid. No clock face, no gears, no hourglass, no zodiac. Its entire folded anatomy suggests an exact configuration held by continuous minute bodily adjustments. One thin sensory appendage unfolds from the knot and points DIRECTLY at the viewer, ending in a subtle dark receptive oval, giving the unmistakable impression that only this creature notices our gaze. No human face, no big monster eyeball. In the deeper background an ordinary medieval worker carrying a tool walks away through the gallery, wholly unaware, softly out of focus. The main creature occupies a substantial part of the frame so anatomical detail is readable. Camera as a disembodied observer looking diagonally up beneath the beams; no visible wizard, no hands, no portal frame. The historical environment continues naturally; do not show time travel, a changed past, duplicate figures or clocks. Soft dusty daylight slants from a side opening, warm aged wood and cool pale limbs, restrained muted color palette, unsettling stillness, beautiful complexity, tragic grandeur, tactile credible materials. Creature is morally neutral, no evil grin, no attacking pose, no magic beams. Landscape composition, sophisticated fantasy creature concept art, no text, no captions, no watermark. Proposed visual interpretation.
